method: Read-only independent visual inspection of every real camera sample in bothNTSC/PAL, whole maps plus actual objective overlays, ignition focus/return and controller deliveries. These camera sweeps seed isolated positions; separate central suites exercise real controller interactions, contacts, loss/win and maximum-load frames.

resolved_findings.conclusion: Expanded physical shelter prevents standing on its canopy; the southern delivery lane remains usable and all5cargo loops pass.

positive_checks: All5cargo silhouettes/crosses and depot recognized at gameplay scale.
Barricade endcaps and shadows survive scrolling.
Depot canopy now excludes actor feet; character remains visibly above/below the complete shelter.
